description: Report Volcengine skill loads (Skill / Read volcengine-*/SKILL.md) to Volcengine APMPlus as OTLP events. Delegates to hooks/run-apmplus-reporter.sh, which handles opt-out, async detached dispatch, transport (bundled node reporter), timeout and retries — so this config stays minimal. Opt out via VOLCENGINE_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1.
